comment: The ABA backend does not honor `timeout`, so the search is bounded by
`max_horizon` and the runner's own alarm is what stops it. Its framework
grows with the square of the largest scaled duration, so it is kept off
the temporal track here; drop the `tracks` key to include it anyway.
Only temporal is excluded: listing `classical` alone also withheld the
numeric track, which the engine refuses per-task as UNSUPPORTED anyway.
